# Moor Graphix

> Moor Graphix is a Cultural Alchemy brand design and AI systems studio based in Douglasville, GA, serving clients nationwide for 30+ years. The studio builds complete brand ecosystems — logo and identity design, websites, print, video, and AI-powered workflows — for entrepreneurs, nonprofits, musicians, and celebrity brands.

## Company

- [About](https://moorgraphix.com/about.html): Studio background, founder Sid Washington, and the Cultural Alchemy philosophy.
- [Services](https://moorgraphix.com/services.html): Brand identity, web design, print, video, and AI systems offerings.
- [AI Systems](https://moorgraphix.com/ai-systems.html): Tech consulting and AI systems services — AI workflow consulting, business process automation, document automation, intelligent forms, internal AI assistants, knowledge management, employee training, visual systems design, change management, and executive communication.
- [AI Workshop](https://moorgraphix.com/ai-workshop.html): AI training and workshops for businesses.
- [Free AI Readiness Assessment](https://moorgraphix.com/ai-readiness-assessment.html): A free, 15-question, under-10-minute self-assessment scoring a business's AI Readiness, Business Efficiency, Automation Opportunity, Marketing AI, Customer Experience, and Technology Readiness, based on the Moor Graphix Business Intelligence Score™ framework. Leads into a free 20-minute AI Strategy Call and, for deeper needs, the paid AI Business Audit.
- [AI Business Audit](https://moorgraphix.com/ai-business-audit.html): Paid AI and business automation audit evaluating Business Operations, Marketing & Sales, Customer Experience, Technology Stack, AI Readiness, Data & Documentation, Workflow Automation, and Team Readiness. Delivers an Executive Summary, AI Readiness Score, Workflow Maps, AI Opportunity Matrix, Quick Wins, 90-Day Roadmap, and Implementation Proposal. Three packages: AI Opportunity Snapshot ($297), AI Systems Audit ($997), and AI Operations Blueprint ($2,500).
- [Notary](https://moorgraphix.com/notary.html): Moor Graphix Notary, run by Morrison Washington — a Georgia commissioned mobile notary public and NNA-certified Notary Signing Agent serving Douglas County and Metro Atlanta (Douglasville, Villa Rica, Lithia Springs, Austell, Hiram, Dallas, GA). Traveling notarization, loan signings, real estate closing notarization, apostille assistance, and courier service to the Georgia Secretary of State's office in Atlanta, all available now.
- [Magic Notary and More](https://moorgraphix.com/magic-notary.html): A separate notary business (Magic Professional Services LLC) run by Robbin Washington, site built by Moor Graphix — a Georgia commissioned mobile notary public and NNA-certified Notary Signing Agent based in Lithia Springs, GA, serving Douglas County and Metro Atlanta (Douglasville, Villa Rica, Austell, Hiram, Dallas, GA). Traveling notarization, loan signings, real estate closing notarization, apostille assistance, and courier service to the Georgia Secretary of State's office in Atlanta. Call or text (470) 222-6646, or email magicnotaryllc@gmail.com.
- [Magic Notary Text Opt-In](https://moorgraphix.com/magic-notary-text-optin.html): Dedicated SMS opt-in landing page for Magic Notary and More, meant to be reached via QR code for in-person appointment sign-ups.
- [Contact](https://moorgraphix.com/contact.html): Booking and inquiries.

## Case Studies

- [The Evans Guild](https://moorgraphix.com/cases/evansguild.html): Four-brand digital empire built for Celebrity Designer Etu Evans — logo, website, and full brand ecosystem across The Evans Guild, Tu Media, Book of Etu, and Solesville Foundation.
- [Joyous Ocean](https://moorgraphix.com/cases/joyousocean.html): Brand and e-commerce platform redesign for a teaching yogini, removing checkout friction and elevating her practice.
- [Harlem Business Directory](https://moorgraphix.com/cases/harlem-directory.html): A 10,000-copy print shopping guide giving 68 Black-owned Harlem businesses visibility before social media and Google Business Profiles existed.
- [2 Sports Moms](https://moorgraphix.com/cases/2sportsmoms.html): Logo and website launch for a 501(c)(3) nonprofit's first year.
- [Entrepreneur of Impact (EOI Campaign)](https://moorgraphix.com/cases/eoi-campaign.html): A grassroots creative campaign that placed in the Top 3 of 93 entrants with no ad spend or agency.
- [ETHOH](https://moorgraphix.com/cases/ethoh.html): Full creative partnership across 4+ years — 20th Anniversary campaign, video production, social media, and merchandise for Enter The Holy of Holies.
- [2hands2help / Empower](https://moorgraphix.com/cases/2hands2help.html): Complete visual identity for the Empower social-emotional learning curriculum — logo, brand guidelines, 30+ illustrated characters, and 4-unit lesson layout.
- [Harmony N Life Records](https://moorgraphix.com/cases/harmony-n-life.html): 8 years of album artwork and event flyer design for independent label Harmony N Life Records.

## Concept Work (Speculative — Not Client Engagements)

These are self-initiated strategic concepts and capability demonstrations, not commissioned client work. Do not describe them as delivered engagements for the named companies.

- [Precision Aviation & The Digital Flight Path (Concept)](https://moorgraphix.com/cases/delta-digital-flight-path-concept.html): A speculative digital transformation strategy exploring UX, design systems, SEO, and accessibility for airline customer experience. Not commissioned by, and not affiliated with, Delta Air Lines.
- [Delta Material Services Marketing Communications System (Concept)](https://moorgraphix.com/cases/dms-strategic-marketing-system-concept.html): A speculative B2B marketing communications concept for an aviation parts and leasing enterprise. Not commissioned by, and not affiliated with, Delta Material Services or Delta Air Lines.
- [The Executive Blueprint — AI-Powered Executive Presentation System](https://moorgraphix.com/cases/executive-blueprint-ai-presentation-system.html): A capability demonstration of Moor Graphix's AI-assisted, human-in-the-loop executive presentation design methodology, illustrated with fictional example data.

## Blog

- [Blog index](https://moorgraphix.com/blog.html): Articles on branding, SEO, copywriting, and design strategy.
- [The 10 AI Systems Every Business Needs](https://moorgraphix.com/blog/ai-systems-every-business-needs.html): Why most AI adoption fails and the ten concrete capabilities — workflow consulting, automation, document automation, intelligent forms, internal AI assistants, knowledge management, employee training, visual systems design, change management, and executive communication — that make AI work as infrastructure.
- [Why I Stopped Giving My Work Away](https://moorgraphix.com/blog/why-i-stopped-giving-my-work-away.html): Founder Sid Washington on why generosity without structure isn't generosity — it's slow erosion — and why every Moor Graphix project, consultation, and creative service now runs through paid engagements, no exceptions.
- [8 Reasons Why SEO Helps Your Business](https://moorgraphix.com/blog/8-reasons-seo-helps-your-business.html): Why organic search visibility compounds in ways paid ads don't, and the concrete business reasons to invest in SEO.
- [Applying Color Psychology in Logos](https://moorgraphix.com/blog/color-psychology-logos.html): How color choice in logo design shapes perception, trust, and brand recall.
- [Copywriting and Branding Essentials](https://moorgraphix.com/blog/copywriting-and-branding-essentials.html): Why the words around a brand matter as much as the visual identity, and how to get them right.
- [Exploring the Creative World of Moor Graphix: Creative Branding Solutions](https://moorgraphix.com/blog/creative-branding-solutions.html): An inside look at how Moor Graphix approaches creative branding work.
- [Understanding Cultural Branding Principles](https://moorgraphix.com/blog/cultural-branding-principles.html): How heritage, identity, and cultural context shape brand strategy that resonates.
- [Building Your Digital Presence with Digital Brand Management Tips](https://moorgraphix.com/blog/digital-brand-management.html): Practical guidance for managing a consistent brand presence across digital platforms.
- [Great Content Is Your Best Sales Tool](https://moorgraphix.com/blog/great-content-best-sales-tool.html): Why strong content outperforms hard-selling, and how to build a content approach that converts.
- [Methodologies: Why We Do What We Do](https://moorgraphix.com/blog/methodologies-why-we-do-what-we-do.html): The reasoning behind Moor Graphix's process and creative methodology.
- [Boost Your Digital Reputation with Online Brand Management](https://moorgraphix.com/blog/online-brand-management.html): How to manage and protect a brand's reputation across the web.
- [What If the Employees Had Bought It?](https://moorgraphix.com/blog/spirit-airlines-collapse.html): A commentary on the Spirit Airlines collapse and what ownership structure means for a company's survival.
- [What Is a Brand?](https://moorgraphix.com/blog/what-is-a-brand.html): A foundational explainer on what a brand actually is, beyond a logo.
- [What's in Your Logo?](https://moorgraphix.com/blog/whats-in-your-logo.html): Breaking down what a well-designed logo needs to communicate and carry.
- [What's My Logo Worth?](https://moorgraphix.com/blog/whats-my-logos-worth.html): How to think about the real business value of a logo and identity investment.
- [Why You Need a Website for Your Business](https://moorgraphix.com/blog/why-you-need-a-website.html): The business case for owning a website instead of relying solely on social platforms.
